title: Adam Mead - VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
60 Years of Berkshire by the Numbers 
The author of The Complete Financial History of Berkshire Hathaway on the data: more equity capital added in the last 5 years than in Berkshire's first 52, and the pivotal Gen Re deal at 3x book.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The interview argues that Berkshire Hathaway possesses a structural advantage in acquiring warrants over long periods, specifically to protect against corporate raiders and solidify its position. It highlights the firm's willingness to take large, concentrated positions, citing examples where it acted as a heavy bond buyer for troubled projects like the Washington Public Power Supply System to earn significant returns. Additionally, the discussion points to instances where Berkshire held substantial equity capital, such as with Salomon Brothers, to illustrate its strategy of betting big on specific opportunities.
